        <div id="cc-matrix-1780436513"><div id="cc-m-7052506113" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7052506113">Kiting In El Gouna</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7052506213" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-7052506213">Kite holidays in Egypt: 17. - 24. 04.2027</h2></div><div id="cc-m-7052506313" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7052506413" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    My Salty Sisters are going back to Egypt! El Gouna offers one of the best kitesurf spots at the Red Sea: Flat water, constant wind and great vibes are waiting for you. And as always: All
    levels are welcome!
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7052506513" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">

</div><div id="cc-m-7052506813" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7052506813">Spot: Kiteboarding in el Gouna</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7052506913" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">
<img srcset="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=320x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 320w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 470w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=640x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 640w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=940x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 940w" sizes="(min-width: 470px) 470px, 100vw" id="cc-m-textwithimage-image-7052506913" src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg" alt="Colombia: kiteboarding in amazing flat water lagoons just with girls. Perfect and safe holiday in Latin America!" class="" data-src-width="1600" data-src-height="1000" data-src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/if5795b1965e4925c/version/1636493479/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg" data-image-id="4441025213"/>    

</figure>
<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7052506913" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    El Gouna is the perfect place for an amazing kitesurfing holiday. It provides warm temperatures, constant side-on shore wind and a wonderful flat water playground for kitesurfers of all levels.
    The lagoon offers a wide, sandy beach for safe launching and landing, as well as beautiful crystal blue water for a great time on and off the water. 
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    It doesn't matter if you are into freestyle, learning your first tricks or you just want to start kiteboarding - El Gouna is definitely the right spot for you! 
</p>

" class="" data-src-width="1600" data-src-height="1000" data-src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i4ab07fd9f6bfb762/version/1777291181/relaxed-hotel-in-colombia-wonderful-place-for-a-kiteboarding-holiday-with-girls-enjoy-the-good-surf-vibes.jpg" data-image-id="4441025313"/>

<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7052507213" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p>
    El Gouna is just a 30-minute drive away from the airport in Hurghada. We will organize your pickup and the transfer to our accommodation, so you don't have to worry about anything. 
</p>

<p>
    Talking about accommodation: We will stay in a wonderful classic Nubian villa in one of El Gouna's most beautiful areas, sharing a room with another Salty Sister or choosing a
    single room.
</p>

<p>
    The accomodation offers a direct access to the lagoon (perfect private beach vibes), WIFI and a lot of space to relax. 
</p>    </div>
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7052507413" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7052507413">Action: Kite, Stretch &amp; More</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7052507513" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">
<img srcset="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=320x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i969e9301f39ea234/version/1777291246/girls-kite-camp-and-adventure-trip-in-colombia-action-and-fun-every-day-all-levels-welcome.jpg 320w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i969e9301f39ea234/version/1777291246/girls-kite-camp-and-adventure-trip-in-colombia-action-and-fun-every-day-all-levels-welcome.jpg 470w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=640x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i969e9301f39ea234/version/1777291246/girls-kite-camp-and-adventure-trip-in-colombia-action-and-fun-every-day-all-levels-welcome.jpg 640w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=940x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i969e9301f39ea234/version/1777291246/girls-kite-camp-and-adventure-trip-in-colombia-action-and-fun-every-day-all-levels-welcome.jpg 940w" sizes="(min-width: 470px) 470px, 100vw" id="cc-m-textwithimage-image-7052507513" src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i969e9301f39ea234/version/1777291246/girls-kite-camp-and-adventure-trip-in-colombia-action-and-fun-every-day-all-levels-welcome.jpg" alt="Girls Kite Camp and adventure trip in Colombia: Action and fun every day. </figure>
<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7052507513" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p>
    Kite, kite, kite - of course this is the main focus of our trip. Depending on the conditions we have one to two (or more) daily kitesurfing sessions during which we will support you to gain more
    confidence on the water, learn new tricks and boost your kitesurfing skills to the next level. We provide coaching, support and fun - on and off the water - for our group of salty sisters.
</p>

<p>
    Beside kitesurfing our retreats offer daily body &amp; mind workouts (yoga, fascial muscle relaxation, breathing exercises, etc.), as well as empowerment activities and kite technique
    workshops. 
</p>    </div>
</div>

<div class="cc-clear"></div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7052507713" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7052507713">Empowerment</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7052507813" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">
<img srcset="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=320x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg 320w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg 470w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=640x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg 640w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=940x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg 940w" sizes="(min-width: 470px) 470px, 100vw" id="cc-m-textwithimage-image-7052507813" src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg" alt="Female Empowerment Retreat and Kite Camp with kiteboarding, yoga, vegan food and daily workouts. " class="" data-src-width="1600" data-src-height="1000" data-src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i36eb44ec52321ffa/version/1636493479/female-empowerment-retreat-and-kite-camp-with-kiteboarding-yoga-vegan-food-and-daily-workouts.jpg" data-image-id="4441025513"/>    

</figure>
<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7052507813" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p>
    More than a kite camp: Our retreats focus on empowering women on and off the water. Together we celebrate every day, session and progression, share thoughts and experiences to be able to
    grow. During the past years we found a very special energy unlocked in a group of like-minded women with the same passion – an energy that is supportive and just unstoppable. Our mission is
    to build a strong sisterhood of kite girls (and those, who want to become one) and to show the world how much women rock on the water! 
</p>    </div>
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7052508713" class="j-module n j-text "><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">As always, we offer <strong>limited spots</strong> for the most personal experience. </span> Because of the private house, this retreat is limited to
    8 spots. Feel free to send us a message regarding information about the spot, transfer, kite lessons, rental – or anything else, that’s on your mind. 
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <b>*What kite level do I need?</b>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">At our retreats, all kitesurfing levels are welcome! Please note that due to safety reasons you have to take kiteboarding lessons or assistance until you
    are <b>able to go upwind in any kind of condition</b> (light wind, strong wind, gusts, wavy spots, etc.) and be completely confident with the <b>self-rescue maneuver</b>.
    <span style="color: #000000;">We are happy to help you arrange everything with our partner school <a href="https://kitepowerelgouna.com/" target="_blank" title="https://kitepowerelgouna.com/">KitePower</a></span></span><span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"><span style="color: #000000;"> prior the trip</span>. Even if you are a beginner or need some
    refreshment lessons, we will still make sure to ride together and share amazing experiences on the water. Of course, our team will provide coaching and share tipps with all the participants - no
    matter the level. </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <b>What is the difference between a My Salty Sisters Empowerment &amp; Kite Retreat and a kite camp?</b>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">We want to shift the focus to the one thing that matters most: Having fun on the water. We truly believe that progression comes with the feeling of safety,
    support and pure joy – and that’s what we want to provide to our Salty Sisters. Empowering each other is a big part of this process, which means we will be there for every little step you do
    towards reaching your personal (kitesurfing) goal.</span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">Are you ready for a kitesurf trip you will never forget?</span>
</p>
